title: CC2
summary: A book that documents the practices of six contemporary visual artists, for AABB's publishing project CC.
credits:
Authors: Hyunjin Kim, Kiljong Park, Gunjung Lee, Particlefield, Kiwoong Choi, formless twins
Published by [AABB](https://www.instagram.com/aabb.kr/)
Publisher: [Jaewon Seok](http://jaewonseok.com/)
Design: Junyeol Baek
Editing: [Sorim Lee](https://www.instagram.com/soriimlee/)
Photography: [Dohyun Park](https://www.instagram.com/dhyvnpark/)
description: CC is a publishing project by AABB that documents the activities of contemporary visual artists onto the medium of a book. This issue, CC2, introduces the work of Hyunjin Kim, Kiljong Park, Gunjung Lee, Particlefield, Kiwoong Choi and formless twins.
